sources.interpretation: Vendor-reported specifications, not an independent benchmark; page has 100/130/hundreds font wording.

sources.title: Brother PE-Design 11 manual: setting the sew type
sources.interpretation: 9 line groups and 14 named region families; the manual groups concentric/radial/spiral together.

sources.title: Brother manual: Basic Stitch Design Factory Operations
sources.interpretation: Decorative sewing stitch editor; expressly not an embroidery-pattern creator.

sources.title: Brother manual: Sending a pattern to CanvasWorkspace
sources.interpretation: FCM is cutting data; route has size/object limits. Does not establish third-party API availability.

sources.title: Brother Artspira current regional page
sources.interpretation: Mobile app, content tiers and compatible machines; capabilities vary by region/version/plan.

sources.title: Brother PE-Design 11 new features
sources.interpretation: Quilting, font mapping, photo stitch, array copies and decorative sewing workflow.

sources.title: Brother PE-Design 11 update history
sources.interpretation: Version-specific hoops/PES revisions, Wireless Link and PMP compatibility; not universal machine support.

sources.title: Brother manual: setting text attributes
sources.interpretation: Built-in/custom/TrueType distinction; minimum sizes; conversion caveats.

sources.title: Brother manual: line sewing attributes
sources.interpretation: Chain decorative pattern and cutwork settings; does not equate chain appearance with a chain-stitch mechanism.

sources.title: Brother creative inspiration page
sources.interpretation: Matches screenshot: projects, tutorials and compatible-machine Artspira workflows.

sources.title: Embird official site
sources.interpretation: Reports more than 70 formats and over 20 machine brands; individual read/write/versions require scrutiny.

sources.title: BERNINA V9 product levels
sources.interpretation: Creator and DesignerPlus are product levels; DesignerPlus includes Cross Stitch and Quilter. Do not treat capabilities as identical.

sources.title: WilcomWorkspace Truesizer
sources.interpretation: Browser view, resize/recalculate, recolour, export and worksheets; not evidence of every desktop digitising feature in the browser.

sources.title: WilcomWorkspace suite
sources.interpretation: Cloud design management and team workflows; do not assume full CAD or digital-twin parity.

sources.title: Wilcom EmbroideryStudio 2026
sources.interpretation: Separate desktop product/version from Workspace.
